what_i_see: A small, mostly vertical structure with an orange/yellow rectangular box as a body and a thin dark vertical stick extending upward as a neck. There are a few tiny elements near the headstock area. The overall shape vaguely suggests a guitar silhouette but is far too blocky and minimal—the body lacks the characteristic curved figure-eight shape, there is no sound hole, no visible strings, and no fretboard detail. It reads more like a generic post or antenna on a box than a recognizable guitar.
